_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Tai giogande a su Golf (Giogu de Cartas) - Giogadore {player_id}.
Obietivu: Otènnere su puntuatzione prus bassa in custa singola borta. Si sas columnas sunt de su matessi balore, sunt contadas comente 0.
Balores de cartas: A=1, 2-10=balore de fàtzia, J/Q=10, K=0

Atziones (imprea brackets esatos):
- '[draw]' - Pitire da su mazzu
- '[take]' - Tòllere da su muntone de cartas atzintadas
- '[swap X Y]' - Scambiare cartas pitidas cun positzione X (filera) Y (colonna)
- '[discard]' - Atzintare sa cartas pitida

board.drew:
Tai pitidu: {card}
Ara devi [swap X Y] o [discard] lu.
board.took: As leadu: {card} dae sa pila de iscadèntzia Deves [swap X Y] cun issa (non podes iscarrigare).

options.final_turns: Bortas finales! Sas tuas optziones: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Deves: [swap X Y] (non podes iscarrigare cartas dae su muntone de iscartamentos)

action_desc.swapped: Giogadore {pid} at scambiatu {new} cun {old} in positzione ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Sa piata est bòida! Su giogu acabbat in presse.
message.knocked: Giogadore {pid} batidu! Ogni àteru giogadore tenet unu turnu de prus.
message.final_round: Giogadore {pid} {reason}! Cada àteru giogadore tenet un'àtera borta.

invalid.wrong_action: Imprea un'atzione cun bracket: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Sa pila de iscadidos est bòida!
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Non si podet iscarrigare una carta pigada dae sa pila de sos iscartados. Si depet cambiare.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Tai unu cartas pitida. Devi [swap X Y] o [discard] la.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Ti serbit una carta iscavada pro cambiare.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Bisòngiat una carta disinnada pro la bogare.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Positzione foras de limites. Imprea filera 1-{max_row}, colonna 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Non si podet batire cun una carta disinnada. Cumpilai su turnu tuo in antis.
invalid.already_knocked: Calicunu at giai fatu custu giru.
invalid.already_revealed: Custa carta est giai istada isvelada!
